what_it_does: Croatian subsidiary of the Pepco Group running Pepco discount stores in Croatia since 2017, selling low-priced family clothing, toys, home furnishings, décor and household textiles; registered in Zagreb.
notes: Pepco promotion rules on pepco.hr name Pepco Croatia d.o.o., Damira Tomljanovića Gavrana 11, Zagreb, as promoter; dnevnik.hr calls it part of Pepco Group, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. Product mix per https://total-croatia-news.com/?p=28454: about 60 percent clothing, the rest toys, home furnishings, décor and household textiles; no source seen mentions groceries or office supplies. Not the same as PEPACO d.o.o. (Sisak) or PEPINO d.o.o. (Metković).
